title: grid
content_html:
grid

In 10,000, dots of colour inhabit a grid and the text insists on the space between them. In grid dissection, the grid itself becomes the subject of an operation. A grid gives each element an address, including an empty cell. That makes counting and comparison possible, and it gives the social analogy in 10,000 its force. The spacing that makes a group legible also keeps its members apart. 10,000 · Grid dissection

Reading note. Historical alchemy. Michael Maier’s twenty-first emblem in Atalanta fugiens places a pair of figures inside a construction of circles, a square and a triangle. In both the emblem and 10,000, a geometric arrangement gives things a place in relation to one another. What does each arrangement invite us to count, compare or imagine happening inside it? Atalanta fugiens, emblem 21
